description: On the countertop in front of you are a small blue cup, a pair of black slippers with a spoon and a tape measure on top, a white phone, a green sponge, and a small box near the left wall. The left hand hovers near the small box without touching it, while the right hand reaches forward to grasp the blue cup as a right-hand object, lifts it up and left over the slippers, then lowers and releases it onto the left slipper.
